rows.grounds: compound of sva (own) and uccaya (exaltation); fused form
sthitapūjām plus ca with sandhi; accusative object with conjunction

items.question: What established worship and own exaltation circle should Pārvatī hear?
premises: Established worship is to be heard.
Own exaltation belongs to the circle.
items.inference: The verse introduces a circle of established worship and own exaltation for Pārvatī to hear.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of svoccayoḥ remains ambiguous between genitive and locative.
items.plain_english: Hear, Pārvatī, the circle of established worship and own exaltation.
